t: Vittorio Matino
s: Celebrated for his exceptional use of luminous color, which radiates from the canvas as pure energy, Italian artist Vittorio Matino (b. 1943, Tirana, Albania; d. 2018, Nice, France) was associated with the Italian Color Field School of painters. Over his long career, Matino produced large-scale vibrantly colored abstract paintings informed by his early investigations of the Venetian School in the 1960s.
